title: Gild
author: Raven Kennedy
summary: A young woman is kept as a king's prized possession, her hair turned to gold and her life confined to a palace. She slowly begins to see how small her world has become and what she might do about it.
readIf: you want a dark fairy-tale-inspired romantasy about escaping control, with a brooding atmosphere.
skipIf: you want to avoid stories centered on an abusive captor and coercive control.

pairings.reason: A richer, more thoughtful retelling with a heroine who bargains her way out of trouble.
Another dark romantasy of power and betrayal in a court that treats a young woman as disposable.
Another retelling-flavored fantasy with a captive heroine and a more romance-first outlook.
